mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the past month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profitability, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, signaling an economic slowdown that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in unemployment rate signals improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate hiring, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 7.0 and UNRATE declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past quarter indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO increases for three consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) decline by more than 0.5% month-over-month for two consecutive months, it signals weakening consumer spending that reduces corporate revenue expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS declines by >0.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.5% and CPIAUCSL above 250 signal aggressive monetary tightening with persistent inflation, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2.5 and CPIAUCSL > 250, or Rank IC for joint signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a low industrial production regime (INDPRO < 90.0), a rise in INDPRO above 95.0 signals manufacturing recovery that boosts corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO > 95.0 and INDPRO (t-1) < 90.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
